'''April 2002 St. Anthony tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Coaches Corner, Apache Plaza, St. Anthony, Minnesota in April 2002. It is known from Alexandre Dufresne's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3612">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-28-coaches-corner-8-27-02d3612/ coaches-corner-8-27-02], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 28 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-28-coaches-corner-8-27-02d3612/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2002
* '''Site:''' Coaches Corner, Apache Plaza, St. Anthony, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 21
